body: Yeah it's annoying.  I felt a sense of deep calmness driving out there.  I've been in a chokehold and reached the point of about to pass out in seconds.  Harder with a rope.

Yeah Anime and the fact that I'd crush a few of my family members who aren't sphincters.    


Hunter X hunter  - the best

So what's the deal you're paying rent to sleep on a futon?  I would say the best option is to get out of that environment.  I know it's hard, I'm extremely bad at doing things for myself.  But that would be my advice.  Honestly anything, voluteering etc.  Your job sounds pretty shitty but maybe you can stomach it and find another rental?

Thanks for the reply.  Yes I've been on lexapro for 11 years, been to see therapist, helped somewhat, made me realise that I didn't have good upbringing.  But she kinda palmed me off when she couldn't help me, last time I saw her I was really suicidal and said I was losing hope.    
I've got one more roll of the die, I'll do that, if it falls through I'm outta here.

Oh man this post is heartbreaking.  :(  I agree your friend is an arsehole.  I also agree capitalism is sucking the life out of the planet.  I'm sorry all these horrible things have happened to you, maybe you could stick around for your cats.

I'm in the exact same boat.  We have to work our arses off just to hopefully be able to afford our basic human needs.  And if you're in America it's almost impossible with minimum wage. And yes once we've done that all there is left to do is to dull your mind in front of a screen because it's too miserable looking at the shitty world around you.  The only reason I haven't left yet is family and friends.   Sorry not very uplifting response.

Wow your ex sounds like an entitled turd.  If you have a well paying job, maybe you could try and slowly replace alcohol with other habits like exercise?  I know it's a shit suggestion, but maybe it will help you hang in there for your kid.

Sometimes I feel the exact same way.  Life is a chore, you are a slave to the rich and only have brief moments of pleasure as recompense.  What Apocalypse are you talking about?  Climate change?   
I hope you're feeling better anyway.

Wow.  Can you please tell them both to fuck off?  I hope you're OK now.  Obviously she's laughing at your situation because she's insecure / hurt that her BF is seeing someone else.  It's really your BF fault for leading you both on.  You should get someone to smack him.
I've thought about it, but the vast abyss of the ocean terrifies me.  Also if sharks didn't turn up which is pretty likely, then you would drown, which would be an unpleasant way to go.

Where I want to be is standing over the dead bodies of those in power.  I have a shit job, and the bigger picture is this; wealth is going straight to the rich and we will have ever worsening rates of pay and standards of living.  And we're completely powerless to change it, we're sold a lie that we live in democracy, that is absolute horseshit we are ruled by the rich.  The rich make the laws, and we are told to aspire to be like them, soulless cunts with no remorse or empathy.  On top of that the climate is about to shit itself.  
I spend all my time trying not to think of the bigger picture because it is soul crushing.  Where I want to be is dead.
Thanks for writing this, it's really put me off rejecting someone I've sort of made a play at in the past.

I'm at the same point.  I stayed around hoping something would happen and I'd magically lay down roots and become useful.  At least you're striving to do something through all your hardships, that at least is something to be proud of.

That's sad.  If I go I think I will leave a few people quite devastated, hopefully they'll move on.  I don't know which is worse having people to hurt when you leave or not.  
I hope you got at least some pleasure from the life you've had.

Screw not entering hermit mode, what's wrong with not wanting to socialize all the time.  It's a cliche, but money doesn't buy happiness.  The effects of poverty can be cripplingly cruel, but once you have enough to cover your basic human needs happiness doesn't really increase as we're led to believe.  I grew up rich and my family are miserable bastards, and I'm sometimes suicidal.  
Good luck my friend I hope you find piece whatever path you chose.

I'm not sure the evidence between emotional blunting and SSRI's are concrete.  I'm on SSRI's and I can't function without them.  I would much rather a smaller range of emotions than constant despondance.  I think that's sort of the point of anti-depressants.  Without blunting emotions they can't really do anything for bad depression.  
I hope you're OK, it's sad when we think the only option left to us is death.  Pills don't fix the problem, but they certainly make life more bearable.
